title: TurboTick
description: A highly researched PvP and performance modpack built to make sure your computer never lags in PvP. Also great for SMPs and servers.
body:
A simple yet effective modpack focusing on PvP and performance. 

# What does this modpack have? 

## Performance Mods 

- Sodium
- Lithium
- Entity Culling
- C2ME
- FerriteCore
- ImmediatelyFast
- ModernFix

## PvP Mods

- Shield Statuses
- Status Effect Timer
- Marlow's Crystal Optimizer
- uku's armor HUD
- Consumable Optimizer
- Gamma Utils (Fullbright)

## PvP Texturepacks

- Low on Fire
- Low Shield
- Fast Better Grass

# **Why this modpack and not others?**

This is one of the few modpacks that focuses on PvP and performance both, having config and settings perfectly set for PvP while maintaining perfect performance - nothing too high, nothing too low. Great for low-end PCs and laptops. Contains every single widely approved performance mod and some essential yet minimalistic PvP mods for the best combat experience.
